name: Responsive image class
description: Extends the core Responsive Image field formatter to let site builders add custom CSS classes to the rendered image, optionally blank the alt attribute for decorative images, and emit a focal-point data attribute (integrating with the Focal Point module when present).
project_description:
This module adds a field formatter for Image field types, to allow classes to be added to the image via the field formatter configuration.

 Useful for utility based styling where images require additional classes for layout.

 Optionally this formatter can also be used to:

 
 Prevent alt attribute output for use with decorative images 
 Add focal point data to data attributes for use on the front-end
